title: 左巻キ式ラストリゾート
difficultyExplanation: Nothing too complicated language-wise but not extremely straightfoward either.
description: Half a mistery book half a エロ本, very heavy on metafiction and escapism, kind of hard to describe but it is one of the most unique and influential books in otaku culture probably.

title: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活
difficultyExplanation: Average fantasy light novel difficulty.
description: Modern day teenage gamer, Natsuki Subaru, is thrust into a mysterious fantasy RPG styled world on his way home from a convenience store. As he searches for the heroine who he assumes summoned him he crosses paths with a silver haired half elf girl.

title: 海辺のカフカ
difficultyExplanation: Sentences are pretty easy for a literary fiction work. Vocabulary has nothing particularly worth mentioning.
description: The book tells the stories of the young Kafka Tamura, a bookish 15-year-old boy who runs away from his Oedipal curse, and Satoru Nakata, an old, disabled man with the uncanny ability to talk to cats. The book incorporates themes of music as a communicative conduit, metaphysics, dreams, fate, the subconscious.

epubMoeVolumes.title: 海辺のカフカ（下）
海辺のカフカ（上）
『海辺のカフカ』の構造 ～作品に潜むシンメトリーと易経～

title: 霊媒探偵城塚翡翠
difficultyExplanation: Detailed descriptions of environments and lines of logic that the reader must be able to understand to keep up with the mysteries.
description: Mystery novelist Kougestu teams up with Hisui, a spirit medium, to solve four different murder cases with the help of Hisui's supernatural powers. (Winner of the Honya Taishou Award in 2020).

title: 裏世界ピクニック
difficultyExplanation: Scifi/scientific concepts and some more advanced vocabulary, but nothing crazy.
description: Mixing a yuri couple (of university students!) in the making with exploring a dangerous foreign world with said world having horrors based on Japanese creepypastas... Urasekai Picnic takes disparate elements and mixes them together with surprising success.

title: なぜロジカルな人はメンタルが強いのか？
difficultyExplanation: Average sentences but there are some baseball and mahjong references.
description: A pro mahjong player explains how to be strong mentally and deal with stress.

title: やはり俺の青春ラブコメはまちがっている
difficultyExplanation: Quite a few cultural references, especially to Chiba prefecture. The main character is quite cynical and tends to go on somewhat long tirades. Other than this, pretty alright.
description: The story follows two loners, the pragmatic Hachiman Hikigaya and beautiful Yukino Yukinoshita, who despite their varying personalities and ideals, offers help and advice to others as part of their school's Service Club, assisted by the cheerful and friendly Yui Yuigahama. It largely depicts various social situations faced by teens in a high school setting and the psychology driving their interactions.
romajiTitle: Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Come wa Machigatteiru

title: むかし僕が死んだ家
difficultyExplanation: Some vocabulary that's fallen a bit out of use, otherwise relatively straight forward.
description: To get back the lost memories of his former lover, the mc (whose name I forgot) travels with her to a mysterious house that was connected to her father. A slightly creepy mystery that kept me guessing until the end.

title: 告白
difficultyExplanation: It mixes writing styles across the whole book, with some of them being harder and some being much easier.
description: "Manami's Death wasn't an accident, she was killed by someone in this class", Yuuko reveals to her students. A mystery about what led to the death of her daughter and the circumstances surrounding it.

title: 星降る夜になったら
difficultyExplanation: The beginning is a little dense and it's difficult to guess what the topic might be if you go in blind.
description: Every four years, during a leap year, the stars fall that grant the people who wish upon them "hope" and "comfort" but take something in exchange for it. This rare phenomenon ends up uniting Yoshino, a sickly 2nd year High School girl, and Junta, a 3rd year High School boy who lacks any kind of ambition in life. But what is it going to take in exchange for uniting the two?

title: 容疑者Xの献身
difficultyExplanation: It's a fully-fledged novel, but written in accessible prose. Occasional math talk can be slightly hard to follow.
description: Yasuko Hanaoka commits a murder and her neighbour Tetsuya Ishigami helps her cover it up. Yasuko is immediately suspected as the likeliest perpetrator, but will they successfully pin it on her? Mystery novel with a great twist, even when you think you know it all.

title: 岸辺露伴は戯れない
difficultyExplanation: The main character is pretentious and that tone is established in the dialog and descriptions through uncommon words; it's a short story collection so there's a lot of new vocabulary every 60 pages or so.
description: Manga artist Kishibe Rohan investigates a series of strange, paranormal occurrences throughout Japan, sometimes by request from a client and sometimes simply out of his own curiosity. However, Kishibe Rohan is himself supernaturally gifted, possessing a power called "Heaven's Door", which allows him to open people like a book, seeing their memories and allowing him to write commands in the pages of their minds.
romajiTitle: Kishibe Rohan wa Jarenai Tanpen Shousetsushuu

title: 響け！ユーフォ二アム
difficultyExplanation: Dialogue has written Kansai-ben that might be difficult to get used to and there's lots of music vocab, but it also makes it THE best story for mining music vocab.
description: A story about a school band's struggle to grow from a for-fun laidback group to one worthy of participating in national competitions, and its members' relationship with music and themselves.

title: リコリス・リコイル Ordinary days
difficultyExplanation: Has some long sentences, character has their own personality so much that you will be bombarded with different manner of speech (Chisato is a menace), a ton of references that require you to know about Japan, movies, the military, computer terminology and the main series itself. Difficulty is a rollercoaster with each chapter due to how unique LycoReco presents its story.
description: Novel spinoff of LycoReco with side stories. Highly recommended to finish the anime first before trying to read this.

title: 竜殺しのブリュンヒルド
difficultyExplanation: Vocabulary on the more advanced side, fantasy story that can be harder to follow at times, and rare but present more poetic bits. If you're familiar with the prequel, I heard SukaMoka is about the same difficulty. Not a beginner recommended light novel series.
description: The Noverland Empire's army led by the dragonslayer Sigbert has long been obsessed with capturing the island of Eden. Sigbert and his army have been rebuffed many times by Eden's dragon protector. On one such expedition, whether by chance or fate, Sigbert's daughter Brunhild was left behind on the island's shores. Eden's dragon found her, cared for her, and began to raise her as a daughter. But 13 years later, Sigbert finally claimed the dragon's life, and "repatriated" Brunhild to her motherland.

title: 河童
difficultyExplanation: Certain words are archaic, some more than others, but in general Akutagawa Ryunosuke's prose is simple enough for a learner to understand. At times older Japanese is used, but not to the point where it becomes an active obstacle.
description: A psychiatric patient, who is known only as "Number 23", tells the story of a time he visited the land of the kappa. He had lost his way in the mountains of Hotakadake and was surrounded by a group of the strange creatures, who then showed him around their home. He found that the world of the kappa often appeared to be the opposite of how things were in the human world.

title: 異世界薬局
difficultyExplanation: Isekai novel with focus on modern medical knowledge, katakana for chemical and medicine are hard to read. Medieval keigo vocab and made up words from kanji to make names. Bunch of Japanese expression that's related to medicine and life.
description: A young pharmacologist and researcher in Japan died from overworking, and was reincarnated in a Medieval Parallel Europe. He was reincarnated as a 10-year-old apprentice to a famous Royal Court pharmacist, had attained an inhuman skills of ability to see through disease, material creation, and material destruction.In a society in which dubious medical practice are rampant, price gouging thru the monopoly of the pharmacist guild, and good medicine aren't available to the commoners.

title: ノーゲーム・ノーライフ
difficultyExplanation: Some characters have very strong dialect or talk in an old fashioned way, writing style is not straightforward, many references to other media can be seen throughout the novel.
description: Sixteen sentient races inhabit Disboard, a world overseen by Tet, the One True God. The lowest of the sixteen—Imanity—consists of humans, a race with no affinity for magic. In a place where everything is decided through simple games, humankind seems to have no way out of their predicament—but the arrival of two outsiders poses a change.

title: 薬屋のひとりごと
difficultyExplanation: Japanese light novel based on a Chinese background, lots of old Japanese vocab is used. Authors employ a wide range of vocab and expressions that add to the difficulty. Even the character names will throw you off because they use the Chinese pronounciation in the furigana instead of Japanese.
description: Set in a fictional country based on Ming-era China, the series follows Maomao, a young girl working as an apothecary in the red-light district, who is kidnapped and sold to the Imperial Palace as a servant. However, she still retains her curious and eccentric personality and plans to work there until her years of servitude are over, without drawing the attention of anyone. One day, after hearing rumors that the emperor's children are critically ill, she begins to investigate the cause.

title: 刀語
difficultyExplanation: Has some harder words/kanji for ability names and the characters speak in an old fashioned way occasionally, but otherwise very readable. Does include a bunch of wordplay though which intermediate learners and below might not be able to spot. Experience with chuuni style games might make this slightly easier.
description: "Historical" fiction novel by the author nisioisin. The novel is about a swordsman who fights without a sword and a woman working for the bakufu traveling across japan gathering legendary swords in historical post-sengoku-period Japan.

title: 魔法科高校の劣等生
difficultyExplanation: Complete magic system, protagonists use keigo constantly, lots of fights with difficult terminology, extensive descriptions (especially of trains and public transportations for some reason), a bit of a tough read for a beginner.
description: The year is 2095. Magic has been tamed as another form of technology, and the practice of magic is now a rigorous discipline. Brother and sister Tatsuya and Miyuki Shiba are just about to start their first year at the renowned First Magic High School of Japan. But the school's ironclad rules mean that the brilliant Miyuki enters the prestigious Course 1, while her older brother, Tatsuya, is relegated to Course 2—and that's just the beginning of their troubles!

title: 化物語
difficultyExplanation: Written by Nisioin so expect clever dialogue with word play and a lot of cultural references, making it harder than average to fully comprehend.
description: The story of Koyomi Araragi begins through a fateful encounter with the all-powerful, blonde-haired, "hot-blooded, iron-blooded, and cold-blooded" vampire, later introduced as Shinobu Oshino. Their tragic rendezvous results in the end of Araragi's life as a human and his subsequent rebirth as a vampire—a monster. However, this encounter is only the start of his meddlings with the supernatural.

title: 恋する寄生虫
difficultyExplanation: The main difficulty is that there are a lot of technical words on pathological conditions and parasites.
description: A sad story about a middle-aged man with a cleanliness OCD who develops computer viruses, and a high-school dropout who can't look into people's eyes and who's fascinated with parasites.

title: 羅生門
difficultyExplanation: Old kanji, old grammar make this harder than your average novel, but it is still understandable to more advanced learners. It's a classic for a reason though.
description: The story recounts the encounter between a servant and an old woman in the dilapidated Rashōmon, the southern gate of the then-ruined city of Kyoto, where unclaimed corpses were sometimes dumped. The man, a lowly servant recently fired, is contemplating whether to starve to death or to become a thief to survive in the barren times. He goes upstairs, after noticing some firelight there, and encounters a woman who is stealing hair from the dead bodies on the second floor.

title: 妖氛録
difficultyExplanation: Written in an oldish style, has some hard words, not too difficult to read past that. Extremely short.
description: A short book set in ancient China that revolves around a beautiful woman named 夏姫. It speaks of the misfortune of the men who get involved with her meet, as well as the politics of the time.

title: Fate/Zero
difficultyExplanation: Sentences are challenging and the author uses a wide range of vocabulary.
description: Fate/Zero is set ten years before the events of Fate/stay night, and tells the story of the Fourth Holy Grail War, a secret magical tournament held in Fuyuki City, Japan, where seven mages known as Masters summon Servants, reincarnations of legendary souls and heroes from all across time, where they fight in a deadly battle royale where the winner obtains the Holy Grail, a legendary magical chalice capable of granting wishes.

title: 幼女戦記
difficultyExplanation: Challenging isekai light novel involving politics, war and some fantasy elements.
description: The series focuses on a salaryman whose reincarnation as the character Tanya living in an alternate version of World War I leaves her to be trapped in an endless cycle of reincarnation. Willing to avoid being killed whilst dying of natural causes, Tanya must take it upon herself to don a bloodthirsty, sadist ego in hopes of joining the ranks of the Empire’s Mage Corps as part of her plan to become a seemingly indestructible foe.

title: 人間失格
difficultyExplanation: Old readings that aren't used anymore, old things that aren't common anymore, extremely long phrases where you have to pay attention to the whole sentence to understand anything by the end of it. Old forms of verbs that aren't really used anymore either. Excerpts of translated poetry that you can't find in the original to compare as it's actually a unique interpretation of some japanese writer. Tough read.
description: No Longer Human is told in the form of notebooks left by one Ōba Yōzō, a troubled man incapable of revealing his true self to others, and who, instead, maintains a facade of hollow jocularity. The work is made up of three chapters, or "memoranda", which chronicle the life of Ōba from his early childhood to his late twenties. One of the elusive "classics."

title: ロスジェネの逆襲
difficultyExplanation: Harder than your average novel. The novel has a lot of formal business, corporate and economic terms. It also has some rare expressions. It can only get difficult due to the words used, other than that the writing style is not hard to follow at all. Recommended to learn formal Japanese words.
description: Third novel in the Hanzawa Naoki series. It follows the story of Hanzawa Naoki, a banker working for the largest bank in Japan, Tokyo Chuo Bank. He faces numerous obstacles from upper management as he climbs his way up the ranks.

title: 鼻
difficultyExplanation: Old kanji and old kana usage, very specific buddhist vocabulary with older grammar and vocabulary more generally makes this a challenging read.
description: Zenchi Naigu, a Heian period Buddhist priest, is more concerned with diminishing his overly long, dangling nose than he is with studying and teaching the sūtras. He pretends to ignore his nose in fear it will be mentioned, and studies religious texts in a desperate attempt to find a person with a nose like his. When in private, he constantly checks his nose in a mirror, hoping for even the smallest amount of shrinkage.

title: 同志少女よ、敵を撃て
difficultyExplanation: Very involved descriptions of historical war tactics, group movements, and general combat lingo are what makes this difficult. The interpersonal and action scenes tend to be a bit easier in comparison.
description: A story about a female sniper and the squad she belongs to in the soviet army during WW2. A gripping story with heavy themes surrounding it.

title: 坊ちゃん
difficultyExplanation: Souseki uses a lot of archaic and rare vocabulary, and some of the example sentences used to explain these words come from Souseki himself (!). It's also sometimes hard to discern whether the narrator (or someone else) is speaking. Nonetheless, his writing largely makes up for it.
description: The main characters takes up a job as a middle school mathematics teacher in Shikoku. There, he has arguments with both the staff and the students. The story discusses morality more generally and is a Japanese classic for a reason.

title: 或阿呆の一生
difficultyExplanation: Shorter than the one above, but extremely abstract with weird pacing due to the disconnected nature of the book. It uses old kanji and kana but the main difficulty is how abstract it all is, rather than the sentence length or anything like that.
description: A Fool's Life is an autobiographical collection of reminiscences, observations, and ideas about a man on the edge. There are fifty-one pieces, ranging from proper anecdotes to incomplete sketches and observations. Again, autobiography is central, with much addressing situations that Akutagawa himself faced -- revealing also how much of this weighed on him.

title: 舞姫（森鴎外）
difficultyExplanation: Vocab isn't too difficult, however it'll be difficult to understand for those not familiar with the style of writing. The story is straight forward and quite short, there's also many 解説 available which makes it a good introduction to 文語體.
description: Story of a Japanese exchange student in Germany who falls in love with an 踊り子 and the resulting struggle he goes through in choosing between her and his career.

title: 三国志1-3（吉川英治）
difficultyExplanation: Uses difficult vocab, but its surprising pleasant to read once you get into it. Difficulty mainly comes from keeping track of what's going on, as the perspective is constantly being changed.
description: 吉川英治's rendition of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Follows the stories of several 英雄 through their triumphs and adversities in war, politics etc.

title: 文學者となる法（内田魯庵）
difficultyExplanation: Classic 文語體 writing. Vocab-wise relatively tame when compared to 魯庵's other works/works of the time. Has references to a lot of other authors, including Western ones.
description: Satiric critique poking fun at the time's literary figures/society.

title: 義血侠血（泉鏡花）
difficultyExplanation: Outdated, rare words. The writing is hard to follow in general, especially dialogue.
description: A travelling entertainer meets a young man who aspires to be a lawyer, but doesn't have the means to. She ends up periodically sending him money to pay for his education, but has to turn to other means after the money she intended to send off one day is stolen.

title: 十二支考1-12（南方熊楠）
difficultyExplanation: Old, scholarly writing. References many historical documents, books, etc.
description: Twelve books, each of which focuses on one of the 12 animals of the zodiac. Each goes in-depth into the history, folklore, nature, etymology etc. of the 十二支.

title: 運命（幸田露伴）
difficultyExplanation: Old. 10/10 vocab difficulty, words that will only show up in Chinese dictionaries, made up words, made up 四字熟語 etc, unless you have expansive kanji knowledge it's a struggle. Hard to read in general, especially if you aren't familiar with 文語體, very long sentences.
description: A historical novel set in China, based on several Chinese historical records. A young man is made emperor after the death of the previous emperor, but loses the position in a power struggle and is forced to go into hiding.

title: 努力論（幸田露伴）
difficultyExplanation: Difficult vocabulary even by 幸田露伴 standards, archaic and dense philosophical text that pulls from Eastern and Western philosophical traditions/religions and has constant references (Especially during the latter half) to figures from Chinese, Japanese, and occasionally Western history. Quite long at 155k characters.
description: Philosophy/self-help book written by 幸田露伴, a compilation of essays originally published in several magazines along with some new essays written specifically for the book with topics covering effort, fate, self-renewal and how to deal with lack of innate talent/illness, among others.

title: 古事記 校註（太安万侶,稗田阿礼）
difficultyExplanation: Very old style writing, very difficult to decipher. Even with the 校註, you'll likely finish a section having no idea what you just read. Many difficult words, many gods with long names that are hard to keep track of. There's also quite a bit of poetry that, unless you have experience reading old Japanese poetry, is very hard to understand. If you are going to attempt to read this, I highly recommend reading it along side this: http://himiko-y.com/scrp1/kojiki--1.html#130419.
description: A modern (for the time) translation of Japan's oldest 神話.

title: わかば＊ガール
difficultyExplanation: Wakaba speaks in keigo but this is the only difficulty, especially considering the episodes are just shorts.
description: Wakaba Kohashi, a sheltered rich girl, dreams of becoming a fashionable and trendy gyaru because she admires their outgoing and carefree nature. With this goal in mind, Wakaba begins the school year hoping to make her high school debut as a gyaru. On the first day of class, she meets the pure Moeko Tokita, the serious Nao Mashiba, and the eccentric Mao Kurokawa, and the four of them quickly become friends as they learn about and imitate each other's lifestyles.

title: ご注文はうさぎですか？
difficultyExplanation: Nothing much to say here, very simple slice of life. Even if you don't understand a particular dialogue you can still get healed by the cuteness.
description: Sugar sweet slice of life, probably one of the best example ever of cute girls doing cute things. Girl moves in to a new town, decides to work as a waitress in a cute café with other cute girls.

title: しろくまカフェ
difficultyExplanation: It's very easy because all the dialogues are slow, use only basic grammar, and the topics are almost all about slice-of-life content. It revolves around two stories each episode, so the predictability of the narrative is very short with the beginning, middle, and end of a narrative in less than 15 minutes each.
description: Situated near the local zoo and owned by the charismatic polar bear Shirokuma, Shirokuma Cafe is a popular spot for animals and humans alike, allowing them to sit back and relax after a hard day of work. Whether it's a cold beverage or the latest item on his menu, Shirokuma finds joy in being able to serve his customers, often striking up conversations about various subjects.

title: 怪談レストラン
difficultyExplanation: Each episode is a collection of three or two short, simple ghost stories. Vocabulary is mostly basic, predominantly slice of life or schoold related. The only more challenging bit is the intro to episodes where each of the stories is briefly introduced as if it were a restaurant dish using some keigo.
description: Each episode will consist of three stories or "dishes": the appetizer, the main dish, and dessert. The first two "dishes" will deal with an ordinary sixth-grade schoolgirl named Ako Ozara and the bizarre occurrences that befall her classmates. The third "dish" will be a standalone short ghost story told by Ako and her friends.

title: ひなこノート
difficultyExplanation: Very simple conversations, sentences aren't too long. The scenarios are very often super easy to understand, even when one's vocabulary is lacking a bit. Some words like かかし might be a surprise to a beginner, but it's accompanied by easy to understand visuals. There is also vocabulary regarding food and theatre.
description: This is an anime in the style of Blend-S. A girl from the country side moves into the city and begins to work at a maid-café where she meets her new friends/roommates. Some of them have quirky traits but they're just cute overall.

title: けいおん!
difficultyExplanation: Easy cute girls doing cute things anime, some music vocabulary but not much. Good vibes, even if you don't get anything you'll still feel all warm and fuzzy inside.
description: One of the original CGDCT anime, protagonist decides to join the light music club and forms an awesome band with friends. They make music, drink tea, eat sweets and have fun.

title: こみっくがーるず
difficultyExplanation: Cute girls doing cute things (CGDCT) with easy to understand language.
description: Kaoruko "Chaos" Moeta is a young manga artist who is down on her luck. She wants to draw manga about high school girls, but her storyboards are bland, her art uninspired, and her premises weak. Her concerned, exasperated editor comes up with an idea: push Chaos to be more social. So, by her recommendation, Chaos moves into a dormitory for female manga artists.

title: ゆるキャン△
difficultyExplanation: Dialogue is easy, the important parts are the atmosphere, mood and visuals.
description: Extremely comfy CGDCT story about camping. Will make you feel all warm and fuzzy inside.

title: のんのんびより
difficultyExplanation: Easy dialogue, the pace is great and the characters don't speak too fast either.
description: The ultimate comfy anime, Tokyo girl comes to the countryside and cute girls end up doing cute things.

title: 聲の形
difficultyExplanation: Bettermelon Difficulty: Easy (1.33/5) • Level Bahasa: JLPT N4 • Kecepatan bicara: 255 mora/menit • Kanji unik: 573 • Total kata: 6,800 • Durasi dialog: 1h 9m — Made it easier from the fact that they sometimes use their hands to communicate. It's a film so it's not too long either which helps.
description: As a wild youth, elementary school student Shouya Ishida sought to beat boredom in the cruelest ways. When the deaf Shouko Nishimiya transfers into his class, Shouya and the rest of his class thoughtlessly bully her for fun. However, when her mother notifies the school, he is singled out and blamed for everything done to her, with Shouko transferring out of the school. Sincerely regretting his past actions, he sets out on a journey of redemption in his third year: to meet Shouko once more and make amends.

title: ゆるゆり
difficultyExplanation: Very easy SoL vocabulary, recommended for a beginner.
description: Classic cute girls doing cute things with a slight yuri twist.

title: からかい上手の高木さん
difficultyExplanation: It uses simple expressions, easy grammar and both protagonists speak slowly so you can grasp the meaning of words very easily.
description: With a smirk, the mischievous middle school boy Nishikata glances over at Takagi, the girl seated next to him in class. "If you blush, you lose." That has been the unwritten rule set between the two ever since they encountered one another in middle school. Day after day, loss after loss, Nishikata strives to see Takagi red with embarrassment, but his futile attempts are only met by further ridicule.

title: 女神のカフェテラス
difficultyExplanation: It's easy because all of the dialogues are simple, most of the words are very common, and the grammar is very basic. It's not very easy because sometimes the dialogue between the girls and the guy can overlap, becoming a fast-paced dialogue. I would definitely recommend it for beginners, but the speed of the dialogue is certainly higher than, say, Takagi San.
description: After his grandmother Sachiko passes away, Hayato Kasukabe returns from Tokyo and inherits her cafe—Familia Café Terrace. He aims to demolish the cafe and convert it into a parking lot, only to discover that his grandmother had taken in five girls prior to her death. They convince Hayato to change his mind, albeit reluctantly. Through this encounter, Hayato eventually remembers his past with his grandmother as well as his love for the cafe.

title: たまこまーけっと
difficultyExplanation: Simple slice of life/CGDCT vocabulary, nothing too hard going on here.
description: Inside the Usagiyama Shopping District lies an eccentric but close-knit community of business owners. Tamako Kitashirakawa, a clumsy though adorable teenage girl, belongs to a family of mochi bakers who own a quaint shop called Tama-ya. Meanwhile, Tamako's friend, Mochizou Ooji, continues to hide his true feelings for her. Their fathers are fierce mochi rivals, but will it be enough to drive a wedge between Tamako and Mochizou?

title: あの日見た花の名前を僕達はまだ知らない。
difficultyExplanation: Bettermelon Difficulty: Easy (1.88/5) • Level Bahasa: JLPT N4 • Kecepatan bicara: 280 mora/menit • Kanji unik: 781 • Total kata: 17,400 • Durasi dialog: 2h 30m — Simple slice of life, no specific terminology, half of the show is kids speaking so it's easier to understand, hardest part is not crying at the end.
description: Jinta Yadomi and his group of childhood friends have become estranged after a tragic accident split them apart. Now in their high school years, a sudden surprise forces each of them to confront their guilt over what happened that day and come to terms with the ghosts of their past.
romajiTitle: Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day

title: planetarian ～ちいさなほしのゆめ～
difficultyExplanation: Easy anime movie, nothing much to say outside of the fact that the robot speaks in a little convoluted way using 敬語.
description: It is thirty years after the failure of the Space Colonization Program. Humanity is nearly extinct. A perpetual and deadly Rain falls on the Earth. Men known as "Junkers" plunder goods and artifacts from the ruins of civilization. One such Junker sneaks alone into the most dangerous of all ruins—a "Sarcophagus City." In the center of this dead city, he discovers a pre-War planetarium. And as he enters he is greeted by Hoshino Yumemi, a companion robot.

title: planetarian～星の人～
difficultyExplanation: See above.
description: Same as above but with an afterstory interweaved in.

title: 宇宙よりも遠い場所
difficultyExplanation: Outside of some characters speaking a bit fast from time to time, this is mostly easy.
description: Filled with an overwhelming sense of wonder for the world around her, Mari Tamaki has always dreamt of what lies beyond the reaches of the universe. Still, her fear continues to prevent her from taking that ambitious step forward—that is, until she has a chance encounter with a girl who has grand dreams of her own. Spurred by her mother's disappearance, Shirase Kobuchizawa has been working hard to fund her trip to Antarctica in search of her mother.

title: ぼくたちは勉強ができない
difficultyExplanation: Very simple harem SoL stuff, nothing hard here.
description: Nariyuki Yuiga, an impoverished third-year high school student, works tirelessly to receive the VIP nomination, a scholarship that would cover all of his college tuition fees. In recognition of his hard work, the headmaster awards him the renowned scholarship.However, this scholarship is given under one condition: he must tutor the school's geniuses in their weakest subjects!

title: 僕は友達が少ない
difficultyExplanation: Once again a standard slice of life romcom harem anime. Nothing too spectacular to note here, all the characters speak pretty clearly and the subject matter isn't hard either.
description: When Kodaka Hasegawa finds out that he will be transferring to a new school, he is determined to make a positive impression, and maybe even some friends. However, Kodaka discovers he is out of luck when he immediately gets labeled as a violent delinquent due to his blond hair and intimidating expression. However, his life begins to change when he finds fellow loner Yozora Mikazuki talking to her imaginary friend in an empty classroom.

title: 干物妹！うまるちゃん
difficultyExplanation: Standard slice of life fare, Umaru can speak a bit fast in certain parts and her friend has an accent from time to time. Other than this, nothing much to worry about.
description: People are not always who they appear to be, as is the case with Umaru Doma, the perfect high school girl—that is, until she gets home! Once the front door closes, the real fun begins. When she dons her hamster hoodie, she transforms from a refined, over-achieving student into a lazy, junk food-eating otaku, leaving all the housework to her responsible older brother Taihei.

title: 阿波連さんははかれない
difficultyExplanation: There is nothing too difficult to see here, it's mostly slice of life vocabulary with some occasional tangents by the main character when he's in delusion-mode looking at Aharen-san.
description: Beginning his first year of high school, all Matsuboshi Raidou wants is to make friends—starting with the cute, tiny, and soft-spoken Reina Aharen, who sits right next to him in class. Unbeknownst to Raidou, Reina shares the same sentiment, but she has a problem. Awkward and timid, Reina is incapable of determining how chummy she has to be when approaching a person.

title: トニカクカワイイ
difficultyExplanation: Very rarely some business terms are used but it's mostly simple romcom vocabulary and sentence structure.
description: On his way home one snowy evening, Yuzaki Nasa's eyes fall upon a peerless beauty across the street. Bewitched, Nasa tries to approach her—only to get blindsided by an oncoming truck. Thankfully, his life is spared due to the girl's swift action. Refusing to let this chance meeting end, he forces his crippled body to chase after her and asks her out. Surprised by his foolhardiness and pure resolve, the girl accepts his confession under a single condition: they can only be together if he marries her!

title: Kanon (2006)
difficultyExplanation: Pretty simple, it's a standard dating sim adaptation. The plot becomes important in the latter part of the anime so it's slightly more difficult than general slice of life anime, but it's still easy.
description: As a young child, Aizawa Yuuichi had often visited his cousin in the city; however, something drastic happened to keep him away for seven long years. Now, Yuuichi returns, his memories of those days are simply gone. Settling into the wintry town, Yuuichi comes across several young girls, all of whom are connected to his past. As he befriends them and continues to interact with them, the long forgotten memories from his childhood begin to resurface...

title: お兄ちゃんだけど愛さえあれば関係ないよねっ
difficultyExplanation: Simple harem romcom, the dialogue isn't too hard and the vocabulary is simple.
description: After their parents' deaths, brother and sister Akito and Akiko Himenokouji were forced to live with separate families for six years. But now they have finally reunited and begin to live together. It quickly becomes apparent that Akiko harbors romantic feelings for her brother; however three more girls move into their apartment and the girls start to fight over who should take care of Akito.
romajiTitle: Oniichan Dakedo Ai Sae Areba Kankeinai yo ne

title: WORKING!!
difficultyExplanation: Slice of life full of comedy so the vocabulary and grammar aren't too hard. There's very little plot until later on which means you can just enjoy the comedy without caring too much at first.
description: Due to his love for small, cute things, Souta Takanashi cannot turn childlike Popura Taneshima down when she recruits him to work for Wagnaria, a family restaurant located in Hokkaido. Takanashi quickly learns he must stay on his toes once he meets his colleagues, including the katana-wielding Yachiyo Todoroki, the intimidating Jun Satou, the dangerously well-informed Hiroomi Souma, the adamantly lazy manager Kyouko Shirafuji, and the waitress Mahiru Inami who has a "painful" fear of men.

title: まじもじるるも
difficultyExplanation: Pretty easy slice of life anime with a slight fantasy twist. The dialogues are easy and the plot isn't too important outside of the last few episodes.
description: After an unfortunate accident, high school student Kouta Shibaki is branded as the school pervert. With girls avoiding Kouta like the plague, truly the young man's worst nightmare has come to fruition! One day in the school library, he stumbles upon a peculiar book said to possess the power to summon witches. Partly out of desperation, partly out of boredom, Kouta decides to play along with the joke of a book, until an apprentice witch going by the name of Rurumo Maji Mojiruka appears before him.

title: バクマン。
difficultyExplanation: Some manga terminology, the rest is pretty easy since it is a slice of life mostly.
description: As a child, Moritaka Mashiro dreamt of becoming a mangaka. But when tragedy strikes, he gives up on his dream and spends his middle school days studying instead. One day, his classmate Akito Takagi notices the detailed drawings in Moritaka's notebook. Seeing the vast potential of his artistic talent, Akito approaches Moritaka, proposing that they become mangaka together. Thus the pair begins creating manga hoping to become the greatest mangaka in Japan.

title: Buddy Daddies
difficultyExplanation: Mostly slice of life vocab and dialogue I don't remember anything that was too difficult.
description: On Christmas Eve, four-year-old Miri Unasaka arrives in Tokyo completely alone, in search of her father. The bright lights and merry atmosphere guide Miri to a big hotel and a man with a delicious-looking cake. However, the child has just unknowingly walked into the center of an elaborate, foolproof plan for assassinating a dangerous mafia boss.

title: 可愛いだけじゃない式守さん
difficultyExplanation: Slice of life vocabulary, nothing too hard to see here.
description: Yuu Izumi leads a high school life filled with one mishap after another. No matter how improbable the situation, unfortunate events strike him at every turn. In possession of such terrible luck, Izumi enters his second year with a single wish in mind—to spend more time with his affectionate girlfriend, Micchon Shikimori. Since they began dating a year ago, Izumi has witnessed a surprising side to his otherwise adorable girlfriend: when the need arises, she turns incredibly cool!

title: 月がきれい
difficultyExplanation: Simple romance story with no real twists so very easy to follow. Characters use simple daily life language.
description: Kotarou Azumi meets Akane Mizuno, a girl from his class, while eating out with his family and from then on the two of them slowly grow their relationship.

title: コタローは一人暮らし
difficultyExplanation: Slice of life without too much complicated vocab, though the main character kotarou speaks weird might be a bit hard to get used to but it's not too bad.
description: One day, manga author Shin Karino is greeted by four-year-old Kotarou Satou, his new next-door neighbor, who gifts him a box of tissues. In Karino's eyes, Kotarou is an odd kid: he speaks in an extremely formal manner, and he lives alone in his apartment—no parents or relatives in sight. But Kotarou neither seems to mind, nor wants to rely on people.

title: ゲーマーズ！
difficultyExplanation: A lot of gamer slang is used, but the rest is fine.
description: Keita Amano is a typical high school gamer living out an average student's life. One day, however, he has an unexpected meeting with the cutest girl in school that makes him want to disappear without a trace! She discovers that Amano is a gamer, and this newfound knowledge incites a passionate desire within her to recruit him into the game club. Upon visiting the club, Amano is forcefully made aware of a side to gaming wildly different than the one he loves so dearly.

title: 彼女、お借りします
difficultyExplanation: Bettermelon Difficulty: Easy (1.92/5) • Level Bahasa: JLPT N4 • Kecepatan bicara: 333 mora/menit • Kanji unik: 1,000 • Total kata: 21,900 • Durasi dialog: 2h 55m — The usual romance vocabulary, nothing much to say here.
description: Kazuya Kinoshita is a 20-year-old college student who has a wonderful girlfriend: the bright and sunny Mami Nanami. But suddenly, he doesn't. Without warning, Mami breaks up with him, leaving him utterly heartbroken and lonely. Seeking to soothe the pain, he hires a rental girlfriend through an online app. His partner is Chizuru Mizuhara, who through her unparalleled beauty and cute demeanor, manages to gain Kazuya's affection.

title: ヒナまつり
difficultyExplanation: Extremely funny with simple dialogues. The only difficulty is the slight yakuza slang from time to time. Other than that, decent especially since Hina speaks slowly in a calm voice.
description: While reveling in the successful clinching of a prized vase for his collection, Yoshifumi Nitta, a yakuza member, is rudely interrupted when a large, peculiar capsule suddenly materializes and falls on his head. He opens the capsule to reveal a young, blue-haired girl, who doesn't divulge anything about herself but her name—Hina—and the fact that she possesses immense powers. ¨Faced with no other choice, Nitta finds himself becoming her caregiver.

title: 四月は君の嘘
difficultyExplanation: Bettermelon Difficulty: Average (2.69/5) • Level Bahasa: JLPT N3 • Kecepatan bicara: 306 mora/menit • Kanji unik: 1,200 • Total kata: 28,000 • Durasi dialog: 4h 9m — A lot of music words but other than that the conversations are pretty easy.
description: Kousei Arima is a child prodigy known as the "Human Metronome" for playing the piano with precision and perfection. Guided by a strict mother and rigorous training, Kousei dominates every competition he enters, earning the admiration of his musical peers and praise from audiences. When his mother suddenly passes away, the subsequent trauma makes him unable to hear the sound of a piano, and he never takes the stage thereafter.

title: 瀬戸の花嫁
difficultyExplanation: Might require a decent amount of look-ups. The vocabulary isn't really that difficult, but seeing as it's chaotic at times, the context might not help as much as more slice of life style animes. Overall really fun. Many animes reference it in passing jokes and art-style, so that's a great thing to look forward to. It's an older anime, so the artstyle isn't as cutesy as anime in recent years.
description: This anime is about a teenage boy who meets a mermaid and following some god-knows-what rule, ends up marrying her. The Seto family is one of two opposing big-names in the mermaid underground (underwater?) world. Harry Potter's wizard society type-beat. After the first few introductory episodes the anime follows the main character's "daily" life with his newly found mermaid wife and her family/rivals/friends. Has many iconic moments

title: はじめの一歩 THE FIGHTING!
difficultyExplanation: Main difficulty comes from the boxing terms but they are explained accordingly, so it's still decently easy.
description: In his father's absence, teenager Ippo Makunouchi works hard to help his mother run her fishing boat rental business. Mamoru Takamura, an up-and-coming boxer, rescues Ippo from a violent after-school incident and takes him back to the Kamogawa Boxing Gym for recovery. Takamura is stunned by Ippo's powerful punches. As Ippo takes the first steps in his official boxing career, he faces off against a series of challenging opponents, each more powerful than the last.

title: 日常
difficultyExplanation: Overall not too hard, although some references can be hard to catch. Even if you don't understand anything you can usually get what's going on from the visuals. You can watch this without understanding anything and still have a good time.
description: Extremely well (some would say over-) animated comedy anime about the daily lives of high school girls. Lots of surreal comedy.

title: BNA ビー・エヌ・エー
difficultyExplanation: It has some sci-fi/scientific explainations but other than that it is pretty pretty simple.
description: Throughout history, humans have been at odds with Beastmen. After witnessing an explosion in the square of a Beastman city, Michiru Kagemori is confronted by Shirou Ogami, a seemingly indestructible wolf and sworn protector of all Beastmen. As they pursue the criminals behind the bombing, the two discover that Michiru is anything but an ordinary Beastman, and look to investigate her mysterious past and uncanny abilities.

title: とらドラ！
difficultyExplanation: Mostly SoL/romance vocabulary. Nothing too hard to follow, though there is an underlying plot.
description: Ryuuji Takasu is a gentle high school student with a love for housework; but in contrast to his kind nature, he has an intimidating face. On the other hand is Taiga Aisaka, a small, doll-like student, who is anything but a cute and fragile girl. Ryuuji discovers that Taiga has a crush on the popular vice president, Yuusaku Kitamura, who happens to be his best friend. But Ryuuji then reveals that he has a crush on Minori Kushieda, Taiga's best friend!

title: だがしかし
difficultyExplanation: A few dagashi words but nothing too hard.
description: Out in the countryside stands a sweet shop run by the Shikada family for nine generations: Shikada Dagashi, a small business selling traditional Japanese candy. However, despite his father's pleas, Kokonotsu Shikada, an aspiring manga artist, adamantly refuses to inherit the family business. However, this may start to change with the arrival of the eccentric Hotaru Shidare.

title: 中二病でも恋がしたい!
difficultyExplanation: The only hard parts are when the characters go into chuunibyou mode. The rest of the dialogue is standard slice of life romcom stuff, so nothing too hard. If you want to understand everything, it's closer to medium.
description: Everybody has had that stage in their life where they have thought themselves to be special, different from the masses of ordinary humans. They might go as far as seeing themselves capable of wielding mystical powers, or maybe even believe themselves to have descended from a fantasy realm. This "disease" is known as "chuunibyou" and is often the source of some of the most embarrassing moments of a person's life. For Yuuta Togashi, the scars that his chuunibyou has left behind are still fresh.

title: 魔法少女まどか★マギカ
difficultyExplanation: Deconstruction of the magical girl genre which means you get some fantasy vocabulary but nothing much, mostly mahou shoujo/witch stuff. It's not too hard but the plot is important so if you miss stuff you'll be confused.
description: Madoka Kaname and Sayaka Miki are regular middle school girls with regular lives, but all that changes when they encounter Kyuubey, a cat-like magical familiar, and Homura Akemi, the new transfer student. Kyuubey offers them to grant any one of their wishes and in exchange, they will each become a magical girl, gaining enough power to fulfill their dreams. However, Homura Akemi, a magical girl herself, urges them not to accept the offer, stating that everything is not what it seems.

title: 坂道のアポロン
difficultyExplanation: The vocabulary and sentence structures aren't very hard, although there is obviously some jazz terminology thrown in there.
description: Introverted classical pianist and top student Kaoru Nishimi has just arrived in Kyushu for his first year of high school. Having constantly moved from place to place since his childhood, he abandons all hope of fitting in, preparing himself for another lonely, meaningless year. That is, until he encounters the notorious delinquent Sentarou Kawabuchi whose love of jazz inspires him to start playing with him.

title: 斉木楠雄のΨ難
difficultyExplanation: The characters can talk a bit fast but other than this should be fine.
description: To the average person, psychic abilities might seem a blessing; for Kusuo Saiki, however, this could not be further from the truth. Gifted with a wide assortment of supernatural abilities ranging from telepathy to x-ray vision, he finds this so-called blessing to be nothing but a curse. As all the inconveniences his powers cause constantly pile up, all Kusuo aims for is an ordinary, hassle-free life—a life where ignorance is bliss.

title: 鋼の錬金術師 FULLMETAL ALCHEMIST
difficultyExplanation: Bettermelon Difficulty: Hard (3.65/5) • Level Bahasa: JLPT N2 • Kecepatan bicara: 353 mora/menit • Kanji unik: 1,700 • Total kata: 93,300 • Durasi dialog: 12h 0m — Has some military vocabulary here and there but overall it's fairly easy from a language perspective with fairly standard vocabulary and grammar otherwise.
description: After a horrific alchemy experiment goes wrong in the Elric household, brothers Edward and Alphonse are left in a catastrophic new reality. Ignoring the alchemical principle banning human transmutation, the boys attempted to bring their recently deceased mother back to life. Instead, they suffered brutal personal loss: Alphonse's body disintegrated while Edward lost a leg and then sacrificed an arm to keep Alphonse's soul in the physical realm by binding it to a hulking suit of armor.

title: ぼっち・ざ・ろっく！
difficultyExplanation: Mostly slice of life conversations, however there is some music terminology that are used and many jokes, some of which may be hard to understand.
description: One day, skilled guitarist Hitori Gotou meets drummer Nijika and is invited to join "Kessoku Band". Together with the other two band members they create various songs and host many performances.

title: 青春ブタ野郎はバニーガール先輩の夢を見ない
difficultyExplanation: The usual SoL vocabulary but with the addition of occasional quantum mechanics terms and concepts.
description: The rare and inexplicable Puberty Syndrome is thought of as a myth. It is a rare disease which only affects teenagers, and its symptoms are so supernatural that hardly anyone recognizes it as a legitimate occurrence. However, high school student Sakuta Azusagawa knows from personal experience that it is very much real, and happens to be quite prevalent in his school.
romajiTitle: Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl Senpai no Yume wo Minai

title: 無職転生
difficultyExplanation: Nothing too difficult, standard fantasy setting with standard fantasy vocabulary.
description: When a 34-year-old underachiever gets run over by a bus, his story doesn't end there. Reincarnated as an infant, Rudy will use newfound courage, friends, and magical abilities to embark on an epic adventure!
romajiTitle: Mushoku Tensei Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu

title: ブラッククローバー
difficultyExplanation: It's a shounen with a magic system so expect some magic related vocab, but other than that the dialogue is simple and easy to follow.
description: In a world where magic is everything, Asta and Yuno are both found abandoned at a church on the same day. While Yuno is gifted with exceptional magical powers, Asta is the only one in this world without any. At the age of fifteen, both receive grimoires, magic books that amplify their holder’s magic. Asta’s is a rare Grimoire of Anti-Magic that negates and repels his opponent’s spells.Yuno and Asta are ready for the hardest of challenges to achieve their common dream: to be the Wizard King.

title: Bartender
difficultyExplanation: The anime is episodical so even if you don't understand one episode, the next one is mostly not affected. Some cocktail terminology you need to pick up but the leisurely pace and mood make it easier.
description: Hidden in the backstreets of the Ginza district is Eden Hall, a lone bar operated by Ryuu Sasakura, the prodigy bartender who is said to mix the most incredible cocktails anyone has ever tasted. However, not just anyone can find Eden Hall; rather, it is Eden Hall that must find you. Customers of varying backgrounds, each plagued with their own troubles, wander into this bar. Nevertheless, Ryuu always knows the ideal cocktail to console and guide each distraught soul.

title: スラムダンク
difficultyExplanation: The main difficulty comes from the various basketball terms, but they are usually explained when they're introduced which makes it easier.
description: The main character initially dislikes basketball but gets roped into it by his crush and soon learns to enjoy it.

title: 鴨乃橋ロンの禁断推理
difficultyExplanation: Mystery vocabulary with some deduction scenes that might be a bit difficult.
description: Ron Kamonohashi was once regarded as a genius at the top detective training academy. But after a fatal mistake, he was expelled and forbidden to become a detective. Years later, police officer Totomaru Isshiki knocks on Ron’s door seeking help on a serial murder case. He finds Ron, now a messy-haired recluse, who agrees. Together, this mismatched detective team begins solving their first mystery!

title: ヨコハマ買い出し紀行
difficultyExplanation: Compared to the manga, the anime OVAs go more in depth behind the philosophical ideas of the manga.
description: After a disaster leaves the world in a state of decline, the remaining human population lives out their lives peacefully and quietly in the twilight of the human age. Alpha Hatsuseno is an android who works at a cafe bordering Yokohama that rarely gets visitors, and is waiting for her owner to return. One day, another android, the courier Kokone Takatsu, brings Alpha a package from her master. Inside is a camera, given to Alpha so she can take pictures to reminisce about.

title: WIND BREAKER
difficultyExplanation: One character speaks kansaiben, lots of slang, otherwise it's just slice of life.
description: Where the average scores are the lowest, but the fights are the strongest. Furin High School is renowned as a super school of delinquents. Haruka Sakura, a first-year student, came from outside the city to fight to the top. However, Furin High School has become a group that protects the town called the “Chime of the Wind Breaker” – Bofurin. The heroic legend of high school delinquent Sakura begins here!

title: ナルト
difficultyExplanation: Bettermelon Difficulty: Average (2.05/5) • Level Bahasa: JLPT N3 • Kecepatan bicara: 225 mora/menit • Kanji unik: 1,700 • Total kata: 177,200 • Durasi dialog: 33h 53m — Action adventure, easy and simple to understand like most long running shounens, only specific terminology being the name of ninja techniques.
description: Naruto Uzumaki, a hyperactive and knuckle-headed ninja, lives in Konoha, the Hidden Leaf village. Moments prior to his birth, a huge demon known as the Kyuubi, the Nine-tailed Fox, attacked Konoha and wreaked havoc. In order to put an end to the Kyuubi's rampage, the leader of the village, the 4th Hokage, sacrificed his life and sealed the monstrous beast inside the newborn Naruto. Shunned because of the presence of the Kyuubi inside him, Naruto struggles to find his place in the village.

title: -ナルト- 疾風伝
difficultyExplanation: Sequel of ナルト above so the same applies. Slightly harder by the end.
description: It has been two and a half years since Naruto Uzumaki left Konoha for intense training following events which fueled his desire to be stronger. Now Akatsuki, the mysterious organization of elite rogue ninja, is closing in on their grand plan which may threaten the safety of the entire shinobi world. Come whatever may, Naruto will carry on with the fight for what is important to him, even at the expense of his own body, in the continuation of the saga about the boy who wishes to become Hokage.

title: 化物語
difficultyExplanation: Slice of life supernatural drama with comedy, a lot of talking, can be dense at times but its most often in comedy skits. Cultural references here and there as they are used in jokes or as mythical creatures the characters fight against. Some jokes might fly over your head.
description: Thanks to Meme Oshino, Koyomi Araragi, a high school student, is able to remain a human after coming across a female vampire... However, since the incident, Koyomi seems to meet girls who have an apparition-related issue. Hitagi Senjougahara doesn’t weigh anything, Suruga Kanbaru’s right arm becomes like that of a monkey’s, and Mayoi cannot find her way home no matter how many times she tries. Koyomi, a Mr. Nice Guy, ends up helping each and every girl solve her problem.

title: 千年女優
difficultyExplanation: Because of the film's conceit of spanning 1000 years of history, there is a wide variety of speech styles, from kansai-ben to archaic styles and vocabulary. However, much of this just provides flavor to an otherwise-simple plot.
description: In the 1960s, legendary actress Chiyoko Fujiwara suddenly retired at the height of her fame. Decades later, documentary filmmaker Genya Tachibana arrives to interview her. When he presents her with a key from her past, he unlocks the secrets of her life story, even as the boundary between cinema and reality blurs.

title: ノーゲーム・ノーライフ
difficultyExplanation: Involves psychological battles where the ability to follow along is pivotal to the enjoyment. Some characters can also speak fairly quickly sometimes. That being said, there isn't too much to say specifically about the vocabulary and grammar being used as it's fairly standard.
description: Sixteen sentient races inhabit Disboard, a world overseen by Tet, the One True God. The lowest of the sixteen—Imanity—consists of humans, a race with no affinity for magic. In a place where everything is decided through simple games, humankind seems to have no way out of their predicament—but the arrival of two outsiders poses a change.

title: モンスター
difficultyExplanation: Bettermelon Difficulty: Hard (3.80/5) • Level Bahasa: JLPT N2 • Kecepatan bicara: 317 mora/menit • Kanji unik: 1,600 • Total kata: 114,100 • Durasi dialog: 16h 12m — The difficulty varies from episode to episode, with some of them having a lot more medical jargon and philosophical terms.
description: Dr. Kenzou Tenma, an elite neurosurgeon recently engaged to his hospital director's daughter, is well on his way to ascending the hospital hierarchy. While preparing to perform surgery on someone, he gets a call from the hospital director telling him to switch patients and instead perform life-saving brain surgery on a famous performer. Because of the switch, a poor immigrant worker is dead, causing Dr. Tenma to have a crisis of conscience.

title: プロメア
difficultyExplanation: Sci-fi action anime film, has some challenging bits but overall is fairly normal.
description: The Burnish are a group of humans with the ability to create bend fire to their will. Burnish first appeared 30 years ago, when an alternate dimension meshed with the one earth resides in. Sentient beings from the alternate dimension called Promare became trapped on Earth. The Promare has a desire to burn as that is how they thrive. They latch onto humans for hosts, and obey their host's will, creating those known as Burnish.

title: 異世界薬局
difficultyExplanation: The story is as straightforward as it gets with an isekai but be prepared not only for intermittent keigo and fantasy vocabulary befitting the setting but also (and most importantly) quite a lot of words related to (real-world) medicine, health conditions, illnesses, etc.
description: World-class medical researcher Kanji Yakutani lost his little sister to a tumor years ago due to ineffective treatment. To honor her legacy, he has dedicated his research to developing new medications for such conditions. But as fate would have it, he overworks himself and passes away at the age of 31, only to be given a second chance at life in another world.

title: STEINS;GATE
difficultyExplanation: Bettermelon Difficulty: Hard (3.20/5) • Level Bahasa: JLPT N2 • Kecepatan bicara: 345 mora/menit • Kanji unik: 1,300 • Total kata: 42,700 • Durasi dialog: 5h 42m — Sci-Fi slice of life drama, you will hear some physics terminology regarding black holes and time-travelling as well as internet jargon being used, although this doesn't make the anime too hard to follow since it's always also explained in laymen's terms and its sparsely used as well. Has some chuuni elements.
description: Okabe Rintarou lives in a small room in Akihabara, where he invents "future gadgets" with fellow lab members Shiina Mayuri, his air-headed childhood friend, and Hashida Itaru, an otaku hacker. The lab members soon face a string of mysterious incidents that lead to a game-changing discovery: the Phone Microwave they are working on can send emails to the past and thus alter history.

title: てーきゅう
difficultyExplanation: Slice of life shitpost anime, episodes are super short so easy to digest.
description: The story follows the everyday lives of four girls of the Kameido High School's tennis club. The series' focus is not really on tennis, but on the wacky and eccentric characters, with strange object associations and even stranger misconceptions, on their many random adventures.

title: ヴィンランド・サガ
difficultyExplanation: Bettermelon Difficulty: Hard (3.68/5) • Level Bahasa: JLPT N2 • Kecepatan bicara: 281 mora/menit • Kanji unik: 1,300 • Total kata: 33,900 • Durasi dialog: 5h 14m — Harder than basic romcoms and the likes, but not too difficult either. Has some fantasy/historical vocabulary.
description: Young Thorfinn grew up listening to the stories of old sailors that had traveled the ocean and reached the place of legend, Vinland. It's said to be warm and fertile, a place where there would be no need for fighting—not at all like the frozen village in Iceland where he was born, and certainly not like his current life as a mercenary. War is his home now. The war between England and the Danes grows worse with each passing year. Death has become commonplace.

title: Serial Experiments Lain
difficultyExplanation: While the anime itself is hard to understand with a lot of symbolism, the actual speech isn't too hard for a good part of the anime. Some of the latter scenes can be a bit harder to understand, but the language used isn't too difficult.
description: Lain receives a strange e-mail from a classmate of her who commited suicide last week. When she decides to open it, it leads her straight into the Wired, a virtual world of communication networks similar to what we know as the internet. With the boundaries between reality and cyberspace rapidly blurring, Lain is plunged into more surreal and bizarre events where identity, consciousness, and perception are concepts that take on new meanings.

title: ハンター×ハンター (2011)
difficultyExplanation: Bettermelon Difficulty: Hard (3.78/5) • Level Bahasa: JLPT N2 • Kecepatan bicara: 353 mora/menit • Kanji unik: 2,015 • Total kata: 230,501 • Durasi dialog: 29h 0min — The arcs themselves can vary a lot in difficulty, from easy-medium to medium-hard so medium seems decent as a difficulty marker. There's shonen lingo as well as general fantasy vocabulary.
description: Hunters devote themselves to accomplishing hazardous tasks, all from traversing the world's uncharted territories to locating rare items and monsters. Before becoming a Hunter, one must pass the Hunter Examination—a high-risk selection process in which most applicants end up handicapped or worse, deceased. Believing that he will meet his father by becoming a Hunter, 12-year old Gon Freecs takes the first step to walk the same path.

title: デス・パレード
difficultyExplanation: The main character uses keigo and the subject matter is more complex than basic slice of life or romcom anime, but it is still not extremely difficult. While the plot is important, the various games are interesting on their own.
description: After death, either Heaven or Hell awaits most humans. But for a select few, death brings them to Quindecim—a bar where only pairs of people who die at the same time can enter. Attending the bar is an enigmatic figure known as Decim, who also acts as the arbiter. He passes judgment on those who wind up at Quindecim by challenging them to a life-threatening game. These games determine if the patron's soul will reincarnate into a new life, or be sent into the void, never to be seen again.

title: ヴァイオレット・エヴァーガーデン
difficultyExplanation: Bettermelon Difficulty: Average (2.72/5) • Level Bahasa: JLPT N3 • Kecepatan bicara: 330 mora/menit • Kanji unik: 1,100 • Total kata: 19,400 • Durasi dialog: 2h 43m — The protagonist typically speaks in an overly formal way, using a lot of keigo. The difficulty of the language varies significantly between episodes. There is a fair amount of military vocabulary.
description: Violet Evergarden was found an orphan and brought up as a child soldier to fight in a World War I-esque conflict. Following the war's end, she must adjust to civilian life. She takes a job as a letter-writer for hire - a strange choice, as the job's demands for empathy and tact clash with her severe military demeanor.

title: ピンポン THE ANIMATION
difficultyExplanation: While the vocabulary isn't too complicated, some characters speak in Chinese with Japanese subtitles and the dialogues can get a bit philosophical at times. Obviously there's some ping pong terminology, although ping pong isn't actually the main theme of this anime.
description: Despite being polar opposites, Smile and Peco have been best friends since childhood. Although the overly confident Peco strives to be the best ping-pong player in the world, he often skips practice. Meanwhile, Smile cannot help but hold back his full strength when playing against others. But when these young athletes let their unbridled ambition go unchecked, the hardships they face paint a somber reality as they pursue glory.

title: 地獄学園
difficultyExplanation: One character speaks like a samurai, there is some wordplay and the characters can talk a bit fast at times. Overall not too hard, but not quite very easy either. Still, the comedy is so good that even if you don't fully understand what's going on you might like it nonetheless.
description: Located on the outskirts of Tokyo, Hachimitsu Private Academy is a prestigious all-girls boarding school. Due to the revision of the school's most iconic policy, as boys are now able to enroll as well. Five boys are accepted but try to peep and get thrown into the school's prison with the sentence of an entire month as punishment. Thus begins the tale of the boys' harsh lives in Prison School, a righteous struggle that will ultimately test the bonds of friendship and perverted brotherhood.

title: ブルーロック
difficultyExplanation: Some characters have their own speaking style where add things to the ends of their sentences or use slightly rarer words so it can be a touch harder to pick up on what they say.
description: In 2018, the Japanese national team finished 16th in the FIFA World Cup. As a result, the Japan Football Association hires the football enigma Ego Jinpachi. His master plan to lead Japan to stardom is Blue Lock, a training regimen designed to create the world's greatest egotist striker. Yoichi Isagi, an unknown high school football player who is conflicted about his playing style, decides to join the program in order to become the best egotistical striker in the world.

title: 闘牌伝説アカギ 闇に舞い降りた天才
difficultyExplanation: Knowing Mahjong is an absolute requirement for this one or you will be completely lost. Strong focus on psychological themes. Other than this, medium difficulty.
description: While mahjong is a game that is often played with family and friends, it is also a game that is played in the darkest corners of society. Nangou is a compulsive gambler who has accumulated debt over three million yen. In a last ditch attempt to clear his record, he decides to wager his life on a game of mahjong with the mafia. Unfortunately, as the game progresses, Nangou only moves further from the prize and closer to death.

A small percentage of humanity survived by walling themselves in a city protected by extremely high walls, even taller than the biggest of titans.

title: コードギアス 反逆のルルーシュ
difficultyExplanation: Mecha action drama, has military vocabulary and a lot of mecha fights/wars as well as political discussions. Because it also plays in school, you can also expect quite a few slice of life moments.
description: In the year 2010, the Holy Empire of Britannia is establishing itself as a dominant military nation, starting with the conquest of Japan. Lelouch Lamperouge, a Britannian student, unfortunately finds himself caught in a crossfire between the Britannian and the Japanese rebel armed forces. He is able to escape, however, thanks to the timely appearance of a mysterious girl named C.C., who bestows upon him Geass, the "Power of Kings."

title: Death Note
difficultyExplanation: Bettermelon Difficulty: Hard (3.14/5) • Level Bahasa: JLPT N2 • Kecepatan bicara: 345 mora/menit • Kanji unik: 1,296 • Total kata: 68,490 • Durasi dialog: 8h 53min — Thriller mystery with crime and supernatural, dense in language, episodes consist mostly of internal monologues and a lot of speaking but no hard words or expression.

Determined to use this dark gift for the best, Light sets out to rid the world of evil… namely, the people he believes to be evil. Should anyone hold such power?

title: 彼氏彼女の事情
difficultyExplanation: At face value it's just a high school romcom drama, but characters speak in a very fast and dense manner. There are a lot of sophisticated internal monologues (often fast paced emotional/traumatic breakdown) which could make following what is being said harder since there is little visual context to go off.
description: Yukino Miyazawa is the female representative for her class and the most popular girl among the freshmen at her high school. Good at both academics and sports on top of being elegant and sociable, she has been an object of admiration all her life. However, in reality, she is an incredibly vain person who toils relentlessly to maintain her good grades, athleticism, and graceful appearance. She cannot stand Souichirou Arima, the male representative for her class and the only person more perfect than her.

title: 地獄楽
difficultyExplanation: Simple grammar, but Gabimaru likes using made-up ninjutsu with made-up readings so they sometimes get confusing. It's also set in ancient Japan and they talk about buddhism and religion quite a bit near the end so there's some rare vocab involved.
description: Sentenced to death, ninja Gabimaru the Hollow finds himself apathetic. After leading a blood-soaked life, Gabimaru believes he deserves to die. However, every attempt to execute him inexplicably fails. Finally, Sagiri Yamada Asaemon, a fledgling member of a famed executioner clan, is asked to take Gabimaru's life; yet Sagiri makes no move to kill him as requested.

title: 86-エイティシックス-
difficultyExplanation: Lots of political/military vocabulary, but surprisingly simple grammar. Will vastly improve your on'yomi skills by the end. Lots of battle scenes, but there is some slice of life littered in through the daily life of the soldiers.
description: According to the Republic of San Magnolia, their ongoing war against the Giadian Empire has no casualties—however, that is mere propaganda. While the silver-haired Alba of the Republic's eighty-five sectors live safely behind protective walls, those of different appearances are interned in a secret eighty-sixth faction. Known within the military as the Eighty-Six, they are forced to fight against the Empire's autonomous Legion under the command of the Republican "Handlers."

title: 逆境無頼カイジ Ultimate Survivor
difficultyExplanation: Same author as above. This one centers on gambling with a strong focus on psychology. It is slightly more difficult than Akagi, because you need to pretty accurately understand the rules of each gamble in order to fully enjoy it and there is fairly uncommon vocabulary used by the narrator in Kaiji's particular style of writing.
description: After one of his coworkers fails to repay a debt, apathetic bum Kaiji Itou is pressured by loan sharks to settle the large sum of cash. Since Kaiji has little money and no future prospects of his own, he is unable to return what his colleague borrowed. Faced with massive financial burdens, Kaiji is given an offer to board the illustrious Espoir—it is said that "one night aboard the ship, and all of your debts will be paid."

title: 約束のネバーランド
difficultyExplanation: Bettermelon Difficulty: Average (2.62/5) • Level Bahasa: JLPT N3 • Kecepatan bicara: 317 mora/menit • Kanji unik: 884 • Total kata: 15,900 • Durasi dialog: 2h 12m — The grammar is very complicated sometimes, and the vocabulary is not that easy. However, the narrative is clear as water, and the dialogues are very well written. It seems like you're reading a novel only made with dialogues. With Violet, even if the vocabulary is sometimes abstract (because of the story), you can almost always keep understanding because of the clearly written dialogue.
description: Surrounded by a forest and a gated entrance, the Grace Field House is inhabited by orphans happily living together as one big family, looked after by their "Mama," Isabella. Although they are required to take tests daily, the children are free to spend their time as they see fit, usually playing outside, as long as they do not venture too far from the orphanage. However, all good times must come to an end, as every few months, a child is adopted and sent to live with their new family, never to be heard from again.

title: 新世紀エヴァンゲリオン
difficultyExplanation: Bettermelon Difficulty: Hard (3.83/5) • Level Bahasa: JLPT N2 • Kecepatan bicara: 355 mora/menit • Kanji unik: 1,400 • Total kata: 50,100 • Durasi dialog: 6h 11m — The anime varies in difficult, in some episodes it is rather easy, towards the end it becomes pretty difficult with intricate dialogue discussing somewhat deep ideas. The mecha and technological terms can be a bit hard at first as well. The rebuilds (movies for Evangelion) are roughly of the same difficulty.
description: Evangelion is set fifteen years after a worldwide cataclysm named Second Impact, particularly in the futuristic fortified city of Tokyo-3. The protagonist is Shinji Ikari, a teenage boy who is recruited by his father Gendo to the shadowy organization Nerv to pilot a giant bio-machine mecha named Evangelion into combat against beings known as Angels.

title: ヱヴァンゲリヲン新劇場版:序
difficultyExplanation: See above.
description: Remake of the anime Evangelion, see above.

title: 魔法科高校の劣等生
difficultyExplanation: Miyuki speaks in very polite speech, lots of technical words, the magic system is very complete but also technological in nature and thus sometimes a bit hard to follow.
description: The story takes place in an alternate history where magic exists and is polished through technology, and follows Tatsuya and Miyuki Shiba, siblings who enroll into First High magic high school. While keeping their connections to the infamous Yotsuba clan secret, they attempt to live their daily life in peace, but Tatsuya is shunned for his apparent ineptness and Miyuki is validated for her magical abilities.

title: サイコパス

Inspectors uphold the law by subjugating, often with lethal force, anyone harboring the slightest ill-will.

title: さよなら絶望先生
difficultyExplanation: Constant cultural references, tricky Japanese from time to time with a weird cast makes this one harder than your average anime.
description: Nozomu Itoshiki is a high school teacher so pessimistic that even the smallest of misfortunes can send him into a pit of raging despair; some of these "catastrophes" even lead to suicide attempts. Sayonara Zetsubou Sensei is a satirical slice-of-life comedy set in the modern day, covering various aspects of Japanese life and culture through Nozomu and his interactions with his students.

title: 範馬刃牙
difficultyExplanation: The anime is full of phraseology, long dialogues that use words or vocabulary that are not commonly used. In addition, everything is pronounced quite quickly and if you do not hear it, you can miss the whole essence of the dialog or monologue.
description: The mauling of a vicious, prehistoric-sized African elephant makes international headlines. Featured in reports of the aftermath, the sole survivor of one of the animal's rampages attributes its death to a lone, unarmed man—unknowingly describing Yuujirou Hanma, nicknamed the "Ogre" and often labeled as the "strongest creature on Earth." Elsewhere, Yuujirou's 18-year-old son Baki spars with an equally formidable beast: a praying mantis.

title: Fate/Zero
difficultyExplanation: Bettermelon Difficulty: Expert • Level Bahasa: JLPT N1 • Kecepatan bicara: 349 mora/menit • Kanji unik: 1,520 • Total kata: 27,499 • Durasi dialog: 3h 32min — Fate/Zero revolves around mythology, abstract philosophy/morality (albeit basic), and interpersonal politics. These themes combined with a vast cast of characters, each with a different, large set of vocabulary based on the time period they're from (ranging from archaic royalty to modern academic), makes for a show that's very hard to follow without adequate language skill and exposure to fantasy-style language.
description: With the promise of granting any wish, the omnipotent Holy Grail triggered three wars in the past, each too cruel and fierce to leave a victor. In spite of that, the wealthy Einzbern family is confident that the Fourth Holy Grail War will be different; namely, with a vessel of the Holy Grail now in their grasp. Solely for this reason, the much hated "Magus Killer" Kiritsugu Emiya is hired by the Einzberns, with marriage to their only daughter Irisviel as binding contract.

title: 刀語
difficultyExplanation: Edo-era vocabulary, complicated samurai imagery with episodes that are unusually long for anime. The plot is not exactly episodical but each episode usually focuses on a different sword with a lot of historical and samurai terms. Interesting and witty dialogue that tends to go on and on making it difficult to follow.
description: In an Edo-era Japan lush with a variety of sword-fighting styles, Shichika Yasuri practices the most unique one: Kyotouryuu, a technique in which the user's own body is wielded as a blade. The enigmatic seventh head of the Kyotouryuu school, Shichika lives quietly in exile with his sister Nanami until one day—the wildly ambitious strategist Togame barges into their lives.

title: 四畳半神話大系
difficultyExplanation: Extremely fast-paced dialogues, constant references to literary works, obscure cultural references and philosophical considerations all dumped into one big pot. It's already difficult in English, so good luck in Japanese. Really good though.
description: The Tatami Galaxy follows an unnamed third-year student at Kyoto University, using parallel universes as a plot device to explore how his life would have differed had he joined a particular student society (called a "circle" in Japan). The majority of the series' episodes follow the same basic structure: the protagonist joins a circle as a freshman, but is disillusioned when the activity does not lead to the idealized "rose-colored campus life" he dreamed of.

title: 平家物語
difficultyExplanation: Set in 12th century Japan and follows the Taira clan and Minamoto clan. All characters use old Japanese and archaic terms making it extremely hard to follow along without subtitles, and requires lots of experience and possibly some historical knowledge to be able to follow along with subtitles if you dont want to do a lot of lookups. This show isn't good immersion material for improving your language skills as its all archaic Japanese, but is a gold mine to mine kanji.
description: The Taira clan, also known as the Heike, holds immense authority over Japan. When a young girl, gifted with an odd eye that allows her to see the future, foolishly disrespects the clan, her father pays the price of her crime with his life. In an era of rising military tension, the Heike are in the midst of a cunning struggle for power, and bloodstained war is on the horizon.
